jobs.occupation: Global Business Owner, Global Procurement, ERP, QMS & PLM Transformation
jobs.description:
Ambu A/S is currently looking for a Global Business Owner, Global Procurement to be based in Ballerup, Denmark

In this role, you will lead Global Procurement through our global ERP, QMS and PLM transformation, turning functional strategy into harmonized processes, clear decisions and measurable value. You will report to the Global Operations Program Director, with functional anchoring to the VP Global Procurement, and work closely with Global Process Owners, site leadership, IT, Finance, Quality and implementation partners.

This is a unique opportunity to shape a major global transformation and challenge established ways of working. It will suit an experienced procurement leader who enjoys bridging business and technology and driving change at scale.

**Key Responsibilities

Your main responsibilities will include:

• Developing the transformation roadmap, target operating model and benefit case for Global Procurement

• Representing Global Procurement in program governance and making timely decisions

• Driving simplification, harmonization and adoption across sites

• Ensuring processes, data and systems meet quality and regulatory requirements

**Suggested candidate profile

****Skills

Skills and experiences can be earned in many different ways, and we understand that the best fit for the role cannot be prescribed on paper. You are however likely to succeed in this position if you:

• Have leadership experience within Global Procurement

• Hold a degree in Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Business or a related field, or equivalent experience

• Have strong knowledge of global operations and end-to-end processes

• Come from medical devices, life sciences, pharmaceuticals or another regulated industry

• Have delivered major business transformation or enterprise system implementations

• Have strong executive presence and can influence across functions and sites

• Have ERP, QMS or PLM experience (ideally Infor M3 or Dassault Systèmes) and are flexible to travel internationally

**Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

Ambu is a company that expands rapidly and has ambitious growth targets. We meet these targets through interdisciplinary teamwork between motivated and highly skilled employees. Your contributions and efforts are crucial to our success and by joining us you will get the opportunity to work in an international head office with an informal working environment.

We offer great opportunities for personal development. Furthermore, we offer a wide range of professional, social and financial employee benefits in addition to exciting job challenges and continuous professional and personal development.

**Technical Services Manager – VELUX Skjern

****Are you an experienced technical leader who thrives on combining strategic direction with operational excellence? Join our production site in Skjern and play a pivotal role in shaping the future of advanced manufacturing, driving technical performance, digitalisation, and continuous improvement across a highly automated production environment.

****Meet your future team

**As Technical Manager, you will be based in Skjern and report directly to the General Manager. You will lead a diverse and highly skilled Technical Services organisation consisting of Project Engineers, Engineering Specialists within mechanical and electronic engineering and analytics, and a Maintenance team of experienced technicians. Together, the team plays a crucial role in ensuring equipment reliability, delivering technical projects, and supporting production excellence.

You will become part of both local and international leadership forums, collaborating closely with colleagues across Operations, Engineering, Quality and Production. The role offers significant influence and autonomy, enabling you to identify opportunities, drive improvements and contribute to the continued development of a mature Lean culture built on VELUX values.

A key focus in the coming years will be the optimisation of a highly automated production facility in Skjern, which will serve as a blueprint for future implementation at one of our production sites in France.

**What We Offer

**In this role, you will lead technical operations across the site while supporting the organisation's strategic ambitions around operational performance, innovation and manufacturing excellence. You will have the opportunity to influence both people and processes, ensuring that technical capabilities continue to evolve in line with business needs.

More specifically, your tasks will be to:

• Lead and develop the Technical Services organisation through values-based leadership, fostering a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, safety and technical excellence.

• Ensure high levels of equipment availability, reliability and performance across production operations.

• Develop and strengthen team capabilities within engineering, technical project management, maintenance and digitalisation.

• Drive equipment stability, process optimisation and digital transformation initiatives while delivering against operational KPIs and global standards.

• Identify, evaluate and implement innovative technologies, systems and working methods that enhance productivity, quality and efficiency.

• Support the installation, integration and optimisation of new machinery and production technologies across the site.

• Collaborate with local and international stakeholders to deliver strategic projects and share best practices across the organisation.

**What You Will Bring

**You are an experienced people leader who enjoys developing teams and creating an environment where individuals can perform at their best. You combine technical expertise with strong business understanding and are equally comfortable defining strategic priorities and ensuring successful execution.

Moreover, we expect that you:

• Bring proven leadership experience from a manufacturing or industrial environment, preferably within a larger international organisation.

• Hold a relevant technical qualification such as Engineering, Production Technology, Marine Engineering or a comparable discipline.

• Have substantial experience leading technical, engineering, maintenance or project teams.

• Possess a strong understanding of Lean principles, operational excellence and continuous improvement methodologies.

• Have experience driving technical development, automation, digitalisation or production improvement initiatives.

• Communicate effectively across all organisational levels and build strong relationships based on trust, collaboration and mutual respect.

• Are fluent in English and Danish, both written and spoken.

**Ready to apply?

**Learn more about the VELUX Group online at www.velux.com where you can read more about working at our company and what to expect of our recruitment process.

We look forward to receiving your application and CV as soon as possible. We are conducting interviews on an ongoing basis until we have the right match. All enquiries will be treated confidentially.

**About VELUX

**In the VELUX Group, we offer you a world of opportunities and the chance to create a bright future. From the forefront of the roof window category, we enable those who live, work and play under the roof transform their spaces and live a healthier everyday life with more daylight and fresh air.

The VELUX Group is an international, family-owned business with strong financial roots and each year we can create real impact by reinvesting in society, our employees and planet through our foundations. With 20 production companies in 12 countries and sales companies in 37 countries, our products are widely available. We employ around 12,000 people, and our company is headquartered in Denmark. Alongside the rest of our values, courage and mutual respect define our actions every day and how we wish to contribute to the world.

**Equal Opportunity Employer

**At VELUX Residential, we believe in fostering a diverse workplace for everyone to thrive, develop and perform at their best, and where you feel welcome, respected and valued. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all, whether you are applying for a role or already a part of VELUX Residential. That means we recruit, hire, train and promote people based on their skills and potential without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, age, neurodiversity, disability, protected veteran status, national origin, sexual orientation or any other basis prohibited by applicable law.

We value diversity and strive to ensure that our employment decisions are fair and inclusive, focusing only on what truly matters: your qualifications and how you can contribute to our shared mission and success.

**Your impact begins here

**As Accounting Manager, you will take full ownership of accounting and tax activities for your area in Business Area (BA) West and become the trusted first point of contact for the local Finance & Operations (F&O) Head and Line of Business. You will keep financial reporting accurate, timely and compliant, especially at month-end and year-end, and help make accounting simpler and more digital. Your work gives local teams the clarity to make decisions and keep moving at pace.

**What You’ll Bring

**You combine strong technical accounting with the confidence to partner with the business and challenge constructively.

• A master’s degree in business, finance, economics or a similar field.

• 5–8 years of relevant experience from finance, consulting, auditing or a comparable background.

• Solid experience in accounting and financial reporting, including month-end and year-end closing.

• Strong technical accounting skills and the ability to handle complex accounting matters.

• Experience performing financial controls and working within a control framework.

• Strong stakeholder-management and business-partnering skills, with the ability to explain complex accounting topics clearly to Finance and non-Finance colleagues.

• Knowledge of SAP.

• A structured, analytical and detail-oriented approach, and the ability to prioritise and deliver high-quality results under tight deadlines.

• A proactive, collaborative mindset, with the confidence to take ownership.

**What You’ll Do

**You will be accountable for the quality of accounting in your area and a visible partner to the people who depend on it.

• Take full accounting responsibility for your assigned area, with the tax activities that go with it.

• Act as first point of contact for the local F&O Head and Line of Business, giving accounting advice and business partnering.

• Perform complex accounting tasks during month-end close (MEC) and year-end close (YEC), delivering accurate, timely and compliant financial reporting.

• Carry out financial controls and make sure control activities are completed effectively and on time.

• Investigate accounting issues, identify risks and drive them to resolution.

• Improve accounting processes and ways of working through standardisation, simplification and digitalisation.

**Who You’ll Work With

**You will join the Accounting & Taxation BA West Centre of Excellence (CoE), based in Copenhagen (Ørestad), and report to the Associate Director Accounting & Taxation CoE. The CoE is responsible for accounting and tax across nine affiliates in 11 countries: Denmark & Iceland, Sweden, Norway, Switzerland, the Netherlands, Belgium & Luxembourg, Finland, Ireland and Portugal.

The team includesAccounting Managers and controllers who act as dedicated finance partners to individual affiliates, while two positions focus on the Business Area as a whole. Your closest partners will be the local F&O Head and Line of Business for your area, alongside colleagues across the wider Accounting & Taxation organisation. Together you build standardised, efficient ways of working that support high-quality financial management.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will be trusted to own your area and make your voice heard, with clear expectations for the quality and timeliness of your work. You will grow by working across markets, stakeholders and finance disciplines, and by contributing to how accounting is improved and digitalised across Business Area West. You will be supported by colleagues who give and ask for honest feedback so that everyone can perform at their best.

• Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 650,960.00 to 956,860.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to own accounting in your area and partner with the business to deliver high-quality results, upload your CV and apply before 19.11.2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

Content Specialist - PR & Journalism

Do you have a background in journalism or PR? Then you already have a head start. At Bonzer, your sense for a good story, sharp angles and solid research is exactly what makes content stand out – on Google, in the media and in the answers AI models give.

We're looking for someone who wants to be among the best content people in Scandinavia – and who sees every piece as a chance to get sharper.

About us

Bonzer is a specialised SEO agency passionate about helping businesses strengthen their online presence and visibility across Google and AI search platforms such as ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini. That’s why we focus on crafting strong, organic strategies and SEO results tailored to our clients’ needs, goals and ambitions.

At Bonzer, we support our clients’ overall business and marketing strategy through in-depth analyses, strategic roadmaps and effective SEO sprints. We value close, honest and transparent relationships, both externally with our clients and internally with each other.

The role

As our new Content Specialist, you'll join a content team we're actively building and strengthening. You'll produce high-quality content for Bonzer's clients – content built to rank at the top of Google, earn coverage in the media and be visible in AI search platforms and language models.

Search is changing rapidly. More and more people find answers, products and brands through AI models. That's why journalism and PR skills are more valuable in SEO than ever. You'll work hands-on with this shift every day, helping our clients grow through organic visibility.

We want someone who's naturally drawn to exploring how new AI tools can make their day-to-day sharper. Not because someone tells you to, but because it's genuinely fun to figure out what's suddenly possible.

We don’t expect you to know everything from day one. What we expect is that you bring strong craft, high standards and the drive to keep raising the bar.

Your responsibilities

• You'll create different types of high-quality content for our clients, such as blog posts, product and category texts, press releases, and graphic and interactive formats. Every piece combines strong craftsmanship with a clear strategic purpose.

• You'll drive Digital PR for our clients: find newsworthy angles in data and client insights, pitch stories and land coverage in global media.

• You'll create content that AI models pick up, cite and trust, helping our clients become visible not only on Google but also in the answers AI search platforms give.

• You'll explore how new AI tools can make your day-to-day work sharper – and share what you learn with the team.

• You'll own your tasks from start to finish. You'll keep an overview of multiple tasks and deadlines, take responsibility for the quality of your work and contribute to your team's shared goals.

Who you are

You have experience within journalism, PR, communication, content creation or similar areas.

Above all, you're a genuinely strong writer and know what makes a story newsworthy**.** You know how to create texts that are engaging, well-structured and tailored to different audiences and formats – and you take pride in delivering quality every time, even under deadline pressure.

Experience with SEO isn't a requirement, but we want to see a genuine interest in AI search, visibility in AI models and Digital PR. Just as important, you're curious about AI as a tool, not just as a topic.

You're organised and structured, and you take responsibility for your own performance. That's why we're looking for new colleagues who thrive in a collaborative environment, value community and share our values, so that together we can strengthen each other and the company.

You have high standards for your own work – you seek out feedback, study the best in the field and enjoy improving yourself. We value your character, craftsmanship and teamwork above all.

You'll thrive here if…

• you get a kick out of seeing your story in the media or your text at the top of Google

• you see feedback as the fastest way to grow

• you like a dynamic day where no two days are the same

Language requirements: You must speak and write fluently in Danish and English, and be a resident of Denmark, as the role is based at our Copenhagen office. Excellent Danish skills are essential for creating content for our Danish clients, and English is our primary working language across markets.

What we offer

• Dedicated support from day one

• Mentorship and skill development

• Working with exciting clients and brands

• Rapid development and career opportunities

• Valuable insight into SEO and the latest developments in AI-driven search

• Responsibility and independent tasks from day one

• Close collaboration with experienced and specialised colleagues

• A strong team culture with regular events and activities

• A growing team of 50 specialists across Denmark, Sweden and Norway

• An office in the centre of Copenhagen

How to apply

If you are interested in the role of Content Specialist at Bonzer, please upload your CV.

We review applications on an ongoing basis, so don't wait. Expected start: December 2026.

We will get back to you directly if we see a potential match and invite you to a short introductory interview.

The recruitment process consists of the following steps:

• First interview

• Second interview with case

• Final interview

We look forward to receiving your application!

Best regards,

Team Bonzer

Department: Global Manufacturing & Supply – CMC Clinical Supplies, Digital Solutions

Location: Måløv, Denmark

**Your impact begins here

**As IT Project Manager, you will lead complex IT projects that keep the GxP systems behind Clinical Supplies reliable, compliant and ready for what comes next. By aligning business, IT, Quality and vendors, you help deliver the systems that support clinical trial supply, on time and in line with regulatory requirements. You will turn complex dependencies into clear plans and decisions, so specialist teams can focus on delivery.

**What You’ll Bring

**You have led complex IT projects from start to finish and know how to deliver in a highly governed setting.

• A bachelor’s or master’s degree in IT, engineering, life sciences, business, supply chain or a related field.

• Extensive experience managing cross-functional IT projects, with genuine end-to-end ownership of scope, timeline, budget and risks.

• Experience delivering projects that involve multiple systems, organisational areas and external vendors.

• Experience managing system integrations, APIs, interfaces and data exchange between enterprise systems. You do not need to be a developer, but you understand the technology well enough to manage dependencies and risks.

• Experience working in a regulated environment. Pharma, life sciences and medical devices are relevant, and so are banking, energy, defence and other highly controlled industries.

• Experience coordinating testing, validation, documentation, change control and implementation activities.

• You navigate diverse stakeholder interests, build alignment and drive collaboration across technical teams, business functions and senior management.

• Professional proficiency in written and spoken English.

• Experience with project governance, budget follow-up, resource planning and status reporting, including clear communication of project status and costs to stakeholders.

**Useful, But Not Essential

**

• Experience with MES (for example PAS-X), Interactive Response Technology, Computer System Validation, GAMP 5 or regulated cloud and SaaS solutions.

• A recognised project management certification, such as PRINCE2 or PMP.

• Experience combining agile ways of working with structured project governance.

**What You’ll Do

**You will own delivery of IT projects in a regulated GxP environment, creating structure and keeping everyone moving in the same direction.

• Lead projects from initiation and planning through implementation to structured handover to system ownership, support and business operations.

• Drive integration and API projects between GxP and business-critical systems, aligning requirements, solution design, interfaces and data flows.

• Manage scope, milestones, budget, resources, risks, dependencies and decisions.

• Coordinate testing, validation, release readiness and cutover, making sure deliverables meet GxP, quality, security and privacy requirements.

• Manage vendor deliverables and performance together with Procurement and relevant internal functions.

• Give senior stakeholders transparent reporting and clear decision material, and lead business readiness, training and procedural updates.

**Who You’ll Work With

**You will join the IT team for GxP systems within Clinical Supplies, part of Global Manufacturing & Supply in CMC. In Global Manufacturing & Supply, colleagues work across the value chain to scale molecules, processes, devices and products for the people who need them.

Your team is based in Denmark and works closely with colleagues in India, while a sister team looks after non-GxP systems. Across the systems landscape, around 40 IT professionals may be involved in your projects, together with external partners.

Day to day, you will partner with Product Owners, System Managers, Solution Architects, developers, validation specialists, Quality Assurance and business representatives. A fellow Project Manager will be your peer and sparring partner.

**What You Can Expect Here

**This is a role with real ownership. You will step into a project that is already moving, with a growing pipeline of IT projects behind it, and you will be trusted to shape how it is delivered. You will have a peer Project Manager to learn from and challenge your thinking, and the chance to broaden your skills across systems, vendors and functions. Clear expectations and honest feedback help you perform at your best.

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 651,000 to 956,900 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position. The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to bring structure and momentum to complex GxP integration projects, apply for the IT Project Manager role by 13 November 2026. Please submit your CV in English. We review applications as they arrive, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

**The position

**The Head of Regulatory Affairs & Compliance is responsible for leading the day-to-day central Regulatory Affairs & Compliance function, with primary responsibility for Omnigame’s B2C operator regulatory framework and for coordinating consistent regulatory standards, methodologies and governance across the wider business.

The role reports to the Chief Legal & Compliance Officer, who retains executive-level legal and regulatory strategy, overall oversight and escalation of material regulatory risk, Board-level reporting, significant legal interpretation, contractual/legal matters and major regulatory or enforcement matters.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Own and coordinate the central operational regulatory affairs and compliance framework, while supporting consistent regulatory standards and governance across Omnigame’s B2C and B2B activities.

• Lead and coordinate Omnigame’s central regulatory licensing portfolio and support the Chief Legal & Compliance Officer and relevant business owners with applications, renewals, variations, notifications and ongoing licence obligations.

• Act as a principal operational point of contact, together with the Chief Legal & Compliance Officer, for gambling regulators and coordinate regulatory correspondence, inspections, enquiries and submissions, escalating material matters to the Chief Legal & Compliance Officer.

• Assist with regulatory assessments for entry into new jurisdictions and ensure that market-entry requirements are identified, allocated and implemented.

• Own the regulatory reporting framework, including reporting calendars, quality assurance, submission governance and evidence of compliance.

• Lead regulatory change management: monitor developments, assess applicability and impact, allocate implementation actions, track remediation and ensure appropriate evidence and governance.

• Set or coordinate group-level compliance standards relevant to B2B counterparty due diligence where required and provide support or challenge on material matters.

• Coordinate cross-company regulatory standards for game, product and platform compliance and support material or cross-functional regulatory matters.

• Develop, maintain and improve compliance policies, procedures, controls, registers and monitoring arrangements.

• Identify material regulatory risks and control gaps, establish remediation plans and provide appropriate escalation and reporting to the Chief Legal & Compliance Officer.

• Coordinate and oversee regulatory audits, assurance activities, inspections and responses to regulator information requests with assistance from relevant Regulatory Affairs Specialist.

• Partner with Product, Technology, Commercial, Operations, AML and Safer Gambling to embed regulatory requirements into business processes and change initiatives.

• Lead, allocate and quality-assure the work of direct Regulatory Affairs & Compliance team members and support their professional development.

• Promote clear ownership, consistent working methods and effective knowledge-sharing between the central Regulatory Affairs & Compliance function and embedded compliance resources.

• Prepare management information and regulatory/compliance reporting for the Chief Legal & Compliance Officer and other relevant governance forums.

• Support the Chief Legal & Compliance Officer in implementing the wider legal and compliance strategy and in material regulatory projects.

**Qualifications And Experience

**

• A relevant higher education degree within law, business law, compliance, governance, risk management or a comparable field.

• Significant experience in regulatory affairs or compliance within online gambling or another highly regulated industry, including experience operating at senior specialist, manager or head-of-function level.

• Strong understanding of gambling licensing, regulatory reporting, regulatory change management and operational compliance frameworks.

• Experience leading or coordinating multi-jurisdictional regulatory projects and regulator interactions.

• Demonstrated ability to translate complex regulatory requirements into practical controls, processes and business decisions.

• Experience managing, mentoring or coordinating compliance professionals and cross-functional stakeholders.

• Strong judgement, organization and communication skills, including the ability to identify matters requiring executive escalation.

• Fluency in English, both spoken and written; additional language skills are an advantage.

****Do you want to join the team?

****Please submit your resume, cover letter, and any relevant supporting documents by clicking the "Apply for this job" button.

****Application Deadline

****Interviews will be held on an ongoing basis, and the application deadline is 9 November 2026.

Drive portfolio governance, shape portfolio management and act as Business Product Owner for Ambu’s project and portfolio management system, XPM.

Ambu A/S is looking for a Project Portfolio Management Specialist to join the Innovation PMO in Ballerup, Denmark.

Reporting to the Director, Innovation PMO, you will play a key role in strengthening how Ambu prioritizes, plans and governs its product development portfolio. You will drive portfolio governance, act as Business Product Owner for Ambu’s project and portfolio management platform (XPM), and translate insights from across R&D into system and process improvements that support better decision-making, portfolio transparency and execution.

Working with Project Managers, Line Managers, Finance and IT, you will connect decisions on product development projects and resources with how projects are planned, prioritized, and followed up.

You will join an Innovation PMO working across portfolio governance, planning, systems and process improvements. Together with colleagues responsible for other PMO systems and processes, you will help evolve how portfolio management is supported across R&D, ensuring governance, systems and planning processes continue to meet the needs of a growing organization.

The role offers the opportunity to deepen your experience in portfolio governance, business-system product ownership and cross-functional improvement, while working closely with stakeholders ranging from project teams and functional managers to senior leadership.

**Key Responsibilities

****Portfolio Governance

**

• Drive portfolio governance through Solution Steering Committee and Gate meetings, ensuring high-quality decision material, clear prioritization and effective follow-through on decisions

• Review and challenge project change requests and business cases, ensuring robust decision material and alignment with key stakeholders before submission

**Business Product Owner, XPM

**

• Own the XPM development and maintenance backlog; prioritize requirements from project managers, line managers, portfolio management and Finance

• Align updates with IT requirements and drive delivery through the IT system owner and XPM vendor

• Train R&D users, maintain XPM guidance and align XPM use with Product Owners of other PMO systems

**Cross-Functional Planning & Continuous Improvement

**

• Facilitate quarterly cross-functional planning, resource alignment and project forecasting; record decisions, action owners and deadlines.

• Onboard project managers and line managers on portfolio governance, submission requirements, approval mandates and escalation routes.

• Identify recurring decision-preparation, planning and follow-up issues; agree and implement improvements with process owners.

**Your Experience And Skills

**You are likely to succeed in this role if you:

• Have 5+ years of experience in project management, PMO, portfolio governance, project portfolio management or a related field

• Have experience translating business needs into system requirements and supported testing and implementation

• Have facilitated cross-functional planning and resource alignment and financial forecasting discussions

• Have worked closely with business stakeholders, IT teams and/or system vendors

• Can challenge incomplete decision material, secure follow-up across functions and communicate clearly in English

• Have a curious and proactive mindset, with the ability to identify improvement opportunities and translate insights into practical solutions

Experience with business-system product ownership, XPM or comparable PPM systems, and MedTech or another regulated industry is an advantage.

jobs.description:
_**Would you like to play a key role in driving high-quality financial control, governance, and technical accounting across an international Group – with flexibility in how you structure your work?

**_Working on complex and business-critical topics, including audits, IFRS, acquisitions, and financial reporting, you will influence processes, shape best practices, and strengthen governance frameworks and internal controls across the Group.

Join us and build your expertise in a leading international healthcare company dedicated to improving the lives of people with intimate healthcare needs worldwide.

**Our Group Controlling and Reporting team is ready to welcome you

**At our headquarters in Humlebæk, you will become part of the Group Controlling and Reporting team within Corporate Finance. Here, you will join a close-knit team of seven colleagues who support subsidiaries across the globe and are responsible for reviews, reporting, and controlling activities. We foster a friendly, inclusive, and professional environment with a high degree of flexibility, where collaboration is strong, new ideas are always welcomed and heard, and we make a point of having fun together when we come to work.

**Be the key finance partner across the Group

**As Senior Financial Controller, you will serve as a key finance partner across the Group, providing expertise within IFRS, technical accounting, financial controlling, and governance.

This entails acting as a subject matter expert on complex accounting areas and being the finance contact towards acquired entities. You will also be the one to strengthen internal controls and governance frameworks.

Specifically, you will:

• Prepare accounting memorandums, supporting key accounting positions.

• Act as contact towards external auditors and prepare audit documentation.

• Own PPA preparation and follow-up in connection with acquisitions.

• Perform monthly controlling of subsidiaries and key business areas.

• Execute financial reviews and drive follow-up on identified risks.

• Handle and prepare annual reports together with the team for both the Group and the parent company.

**You combine strong financial expertise with a business-oriented mindset

**In this role, you need to have the ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments, taking ownership of activities and projects as well as engaging and collaborating with stakeholders across functions and geographies. Also, your exceptional business insight and perceptive mindset enable you to effectively organise and prioritise tasks, while identifying practical solutions to complex challenges.

Finally, we imagine that you:

• Hold an MSc in Business Administration and Auditing (cand.merc.aud.) or a Bachelor of Commerce (HD).

• Have solid experience from a similar role, for example, as an auditor, financial controller, risk & control consultant, or operational control & compliance manager.

• May have experience from an accountancy firm, though this is an advantage and not a prerequisite.

• Possess a deep understanding of financial statements and accounting, including identifying issues and solutions.

• Have strong knowledge of the technical aspects of IFRS.

• Are fluent in English.

**Interested?

**If you would like to know more about this position, please contact Senior Director, Jesper S. Lauesen at dkjgh@coloplast.com

We continuously review applications, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. The position will remain open until a suitable candidate is found.

Set the direction for everything we build - and start hands-on

DOVISTA is building a new digital capability. Digital Innovation & AI brings enterprise architecture, digital innovation and AI together in one department with a clear purpose: set the direction for our future IT landscape, build the shared data, AI and integration platforms our solutions stand on, and build the digital products that make it easier for dealers, partners and colleagues to work with our brands.

We are looking for a Product Leader who will own the direction of every product the department builds, and who wants to roll up their sleeves from day one. Your first assignment is to be Product Leader for the digital products we are already building, and to take on the hands-on product management work yourself. There is a lot to define: vision, mission, scope, roadmap and the dependencies between projects. You will find the right people in the business and in IT, bring them together and make sure what we build moves both our KPIs and our architecture in the right direction.

About the department

Digital Innovation & AI is part of the group function Digital Solutions and has three areas:

• Enterprise Architecture - owns the IT target architecture, architecture principles and the architecture board

• Digital Innovation - builds new digital products for customers, partners and colleagues

• AI - builds AI solutions and the shared AI capabilities other products reuse across DOVISTA

Responsibilities

Own our new digital products, hands-on

• Define and anchor vision, mission and scope across our new digital products

• Build one integrated roadmap and manage dependencies to data, product master data, ERP, CRM and integration projects

• Own backlog priorities with the delivery teams, balancing improvements in live markets with the longer-term platform

• Run discovery with sales, sales support and dealers so we solve the real problems before we build

Align people and decisions

• Identify who in the business and in IT needs to be involved, and set up the stakeholder map and governance

• Facilitate alignment on vision, scope, roadmap and trade-offs, from working level to executive management and steering groups

• Communicate progress, decisions and value clearly and honestly across brands and markets

Tie every delivery to measurable value

• Define the KPIs that show whether a solution drives efficiency or growth, e.g. automation rate, quote lead time, hit rate, cost to serve and adoption

• Establish baselines before we build and track value after we release

Ascendis Pharma is a global biopharmaceutical company committed to making a meaningful difference in patients' lives. Guided by our core values of Patients, Science, and Passion, we are applying our innovative TransCon® technology platform to fulfill our mission of developing new therapies that demonstrate best-in-class potential to address unmet medical needs.

At our headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark, research facilities in Heidelberg, Germany, and additional offices across Europe and the United States, we are advancing programs in our Endocrinology Rare Disease and Oncology portfolios. We also collaborate with partners on the development of TransCon-based products in other therapeutic areas and markets.

Our Pharmacometrics Department supports every asset in the Ascendis portfolio and acts as a strategic partner throughout development, from innovation and early research through translational and clinical development, regulatory submissions, and life cycle management. Each pharmacometrician contributes directly to development strategy and portfolio decisions.

We are seeking an experienced hands-on Specialist/Senior Specialist Pharmacometrician who can address complex development questions and translate quantitative insights into actionable recommendations. You will apply model-informed drug development in rare diseases, where quantitative methods can directly inform trial design, dose selection, and evidence generation in small patient populations. You will gain exposure across translational and development stages and contribute to projects throughout the portfolio, providing broad visibility and influence within the company.

This is an exciting opportunity to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and collaborate with cross-functional, global teams working together to achieve extraordinary results. You will work both independently and in close collaboration with colleagues in Pharmacometrics, global project teams, external partners, and consultants. You will be joining the growing Pharmacometrics Department and report directly to Kristin Carlsson Petri, Senior Director and Head of Pharmacometrics, who is based in Hellerup. You will also be based in Hellerup. The team includes in-house pharmacometricians, a pharmacometrics programmer, and external consultants working remotely.

• 
Develop model-informed drug development strategies for translational and clinical-stage projects and ensure optimal use of pharmacometric methods to inform trial and program design

• 
Shape regulatory strategy and represent pharmacometrics in global health authority interactions

• 
Inform dose selection, trial design, regulatory strategy, and lifecycle decisions through population PK/PD modeling, simulation, exposure-response analysis, and quantitative benefit-risk assessment

• 
Translate quantitative results into clear recommendations to project teams, senior management, health authorities, external partners or organizations

• 
Plan, document and report pharmacometric analyses in accordance with internal quality standards and global regulatory submission requirements

• 
Strengthen departmental methods, standards and capabilities through peer reviews, knowledge sharing, and continued development of the department's modeling and reporting environment

You hold a PhD, MSc, or equivalent qualification in pharmacometrics, pharmaceutical sciences, pharmacokinetics, mathematics, engineering, or another relevant quantitative discipline. You have relevant experience with PK/PD modeling and model-informed drug development.

• Strong programming skills and technical expertise to organize, perform, document, and report pharmacometric analyses to submission standard

• Experience with translational and clinical-stage analyses, including population PK, PK/PD, exposure-response, dose selection, and trial-design questions

Three agendas connect directly to growth along two vectors: winning more clinics and customers (points of sale) and expanding what each customer uses and pays for (product depth and ASP). Platform consolidation underpins all three.

• Manage: Global Scaling to Enterprise & US Market Evolve Manage for enterprise scalability, security, integrations and governance, with standardised workflows across clinics and regions. Sequence market entry deliberately rather than opportunistically.

• Next-Generation Hospital Software: Set direction for and deliver a modern, future-proof hospital platform. Define the product configuration needed for broader global expansion without compromising the depth hospital customers require.

• AI: From Roadmap to Recurring Revenue Move planned AI categories from build to commercial launch on time and to a high quality bar. Drive attachment until AI is a differentiator in every deal and a recurring contributor to ARR.

• One Coherent Platform: Reduce the number of legacy systems and build the shared foundation that makes the three agendas above deliverable.

Success Criteria:

First 6–12 Months:

• A clear, prioritised and communicated product and technology roadmap addressing 2 main Goals; Enterprise Expansion & US Market Entry, understood and supported by the Executive Management Team and the Board.

• A decided and initiated plan for next-generation hospital software, built on one coherent foundation.

• A defined target architecture and a legacy consolidation plan with milestones.

• A defined AI approach across the portfolio, with concrete initiatives linked to customer value and ARR potential.

• Clear build-versus-buy principles and a product-led view on M&A opportunities.

• A product and technology organisation with clear roles, one planning rhythm and agreed delivery metrics to increase velocity and throughput.

What You Bring:

• Senior leadership of both product management and engineering (CPTO, CPO, CTO or SVP level) in B2B SaaS or vertical software.

• A record of turning market insight into a portfolio strategy that grows ARR, including pricing and packaging.

• Experience building and leading multinational, distributed teams and developing strong leaders.

• Platform modernisation, legacy consolidation and M&A integration experience.

• Hands-on understanding of where AI creates real customer and business value.

• Credibility with engineers and in C-level customer conversations.

• PE-backed or high-growth experience is a clear advantage; healthtech or regulated industries a plus.

Personal Qualities:

• Strategic: Think in wholes, long horizons and business value, and turn this into concrete, prioritised choices.

• Technology fluent: Credible with architects and engineers, and able to explain technical trade-offs in business terms.

• Commercial: Understand the link between product, sales and earnings, and drive growth through the product.

• Execution-strong: Balance ambition with pragmatic delivery and measurable results.

• Clear communicator: Explain product and technology choices simply and convincingly, and builds buy-in from the Board to the team.

• Empowering leader: Build strong teams and develop people, in line with our values: Cutting-edge, Attentive, Resourceful, Ethical/Transparent.

• Purpose-driven: Motivated by improving access to hearing healthcare.

• Robust: Collaborative, and able to make clear choices when priorities compete.

How We Work:

Agile, direct and non-political. We say it like it is, make the tough calls and like to see people grow and deliver results. Our values are all about C. A. R. E. - Cutting-edge, Attentive, Resourceful, Ethical/Transparent.

What We Offer:

A central value-creation role in an Insight Partners-backed software company with an ambitious growth plan and a clear purpose. The CPTO owns the full product and technology agenda, takes a defining role in the growth journey, and has access to Auditdata’s Management Incentive Programme.

Your journey with us:

We want you to get to know us as well as we get to know you.

• Introductory call (online) with our Talent Partner;

• Value fit meeting (online) with our Chief People Officer, followed by a behavioural profile (such as DISC);

• Executive interview (online) with our Chief Executive Officer;

• Copenhagen visit (in-person): meet the team at our HQ and present a case on a real challenge we’re tackling;

• Final interview (online) with the Board.

Throughout, you’ll get timely feedback and plenty of room to ask your own questions.

We look forward to your application! (please submit your CV in English and why this role interests you)

Auditdata is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to create diverse work environment free of discrimination and harassment. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills.

PanTarg

PanTarg is a Danish biotechnology company developing novel anti-cancer therapies in the form of antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs) for the treatment of aggressive cancers with high unmet medical need.

Our work is based on more than 30 years of research conducted at Rigshospitalet and University of Copenhagen, and our vision is to enable novel treatment options for cancer patients via a novel first-in-class approach to targeted therapy.

We are currently incubated at the BioInnovation Institute (BII), a Copenhagen-based incubation hub for biotech startups in Europe. Here, we are currently progressing through preclinical development, aiming to reach a stage of clinical testing within a few years.

The position

We are looking for a Staff Scientist to join our team on site at BII. We are looking for a candidate with robust experimental experience with both in vivo xenograft studies as well as in vitro methods such as assay development, ELISA, flow cytometry and dose-response studies of drug candidates in cell culture. The selected candidate will generate data that supports our early translational activities, our non-clinical safety studies, and business decisions.

Qualifications

In vivo experience – Xenograft models

• Robust (5+ years) of hands-on experience with xenograft models of cancer, including CDX, PDX and orthotopic models.

• Strong practical experience with standard in vivo procedures, including I.V. injection via tail vein (must-have), blood collection, tissue collection, necropsy and general animal monitoring. Experience in preparing drug formulations and dosing solutions for administration, including appropriate handling and preparation of injectable drug candidates, is also required.

• Experience in the context of pharmacokinetic (PK) studies will be considered an advantage.

• Experience in planning, conducting and monitoring in vivo studies, as well as managing external CROs conducting such studies.

In vitro experience – Laboratory assays and protein characterization

• 5+ years of hands-on laboratory experience, with a strong focus on assay development, optimization and protocol troubleshooting.

• Experience with relevant assays and techniques, including ELISA, flow cytometry (multicolor panels) and dose-response studies of drug candidates in standard cell culture models.

• Good understanding of antibody biology and properties, as well as protein characterization, antibody concentration determination and purity assessment using techniques such as UV-Vis spectrophotometry, SDS-PAGE and Western blotting.

• Experience with additional laboratory methods and assay platforms is also relevant.

Data analysis and reporting

• Experience in analyzing, interpreting and presenting experimental data from both in vivo and in vitro studies.

• Ability to perform relevant statistical analyses, generate graphs and visualize experimental results.

• Experience in preparing clear and structured experimental reports and presenting study results and conclusions.

Other qualifications

• The optimal candidate will have obtained a PhD degree and have at least 4-5 years of experience from either pharma or biotech, or as a post doc.

• Good scientific project management and communications skills, and the ability to clearly and precisely present data to a professional audience.

• Good interpersonal skills, and the ability to thrive in a startup environment where flexibility and a can-do attitude is part of everyday work life.

• Fluent in the English language, written as well as spoken.

• On-site presence at the BioInnovation Institute in Copenhagen will be required.

General information and how to apply

• 
You will be reporting to the Chief Scientific Officer.

• 
The position is full time.

• 
Interviews will be conducted on an ongoing basis, and the selected candidate will start as soon as possible.

• 
Application takes place via the application system here at LinkedIn.

• 
Please provide and combine, in a single file (PDF), a one-page CV, as well as a short, motivated application letter (also one page), summarizing your relevant experience, key responsibilities in previous roles, and motivation for applying for the position. Note that the application system only allows uploading of a single document.

• 
Questions about the open position should be addressed to the e-mail address jobs@pantarg.com

**Market Director Health and Public Institutions – Buildings & Industry

**__**Lyngby or Aarhus, Odense or Vejle

**_

_**Do you want to help shape some of Denmark's and the Nordic region's most important healthcare, education and public building projects? Can you build trusted relationships with key clients, grow business opportunities, and lead complex pursuits in a market with significant societal impact? And do you combine solid commercial acumen with deep insight into the health and public institutions sector? Then join COWI as our new Market Director for Health & Public Institutions within Buildings & Industry and apply your knowledge and curiosity to enable a better tomorrow.

**_

_**Shape the future of healthcare and public buildings

**_To strengthen COWI’s customer-centric approach, we are looking for a Market Director to drive business development and coordinate sales efforts within Health & Public Institutions in our Buildings & Industry sector.

This is a key role in one of COWI’s strategic growth markets, covering healthcare, education, research, cultural facilities and public development projects across Denmark and the Nordics. You will help position COWI on major hospital developments, universities, public institutions, refurbishment programmes and other complex projects that contribute to the development of society.

What makes this role unique is its pure focus on market leadership, where success is defined by customer value, business growth, and a strong market presence. Working closely with specialists, project managers and technical experts, you will build relationships, identify opportunities and grow COWI’s presence in the market. You will also become part of an experienced business development community that shares best practices and drives commercial excellence across COWI.

As part of a team of 25 experienced market professionals across COWI and Arkitema, you will work at the forefront of our business development efforts. Reporting to the Senior Market Director, you will collaborate closely with colleagues across the organization to deepen client relationships, unlock strategic opportunities, and lead pursuits from early engagement through to project win, contributing directly to the continued growth of our business.

With increasing investments in healthcare, public buildings and sustainable transformation, the market offers significant growth potential. Your sector insight, commercial mindset and customer understanding will help position COWI as a preferred partner for public clients and healthcare organisations across the Nordic region.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Grow business development and growth across the Health & Public Institutions market segment by identifying, prioritizing, and converting strategic opportunities.

• Build and maintain close relationships with key customers, partners, and decisionmakers, acting as a trusted advisor and Key Account Manager for selected clients.

• Develop and manage a healthy sales pipeline, manage Go/No-Go decisions, and drive capture planning for major pursuits and tenders.

Lead and support complex proposal processes, ensuring compelling value propositions and effective collaboration across disciplines and business units.

• Provide direction and coordination for the Business Development team supporting the market segment, ensuring effective collaboration and delivery of market priorities.

• Monitor market trends, upcoming investments, and customer needs to help shape market strategies and long-term growth initiatives.

• Represent COWI externally through customer meetings, industry networks, conferences, and strategic partnerships.

**Your skills. Our team. Together we design the future.

**Like us, you believe that successful business development is built on trust, collaboration and long-term relationships. You are motivated by creating opportunities, understanding customer needs and bringing together the best teams to deliver value for clients and society. You thrive in a collaborative environment and enjoy working closely with fellow Market Directors and multidisciplinary teams to achieve shared goals.

To perform well in this role, it is essential that you bring solid market insight and a well-established network within healthcare, public institutions or the built environment sector. Equally important is your ability to build internal alliances and leverage the collective expertise of the organisation rather than acting alone.

On top of that, you will have:

• A relevant educational background such as engineering, architecture, business or a related discipline.

• Extensive experience in business development, client management, or market leadership within healthcare, public institutions, architecture, construction, or engineering consultancy.

• Deep knowledge of public-sector customers, procurement processes, and market dynamics, combined with a well-established professional network.

• Demonstrated skill in building trusted relationships with senior stakeholders and converting opportunities into long-term partnerships.

• Experience contributing to large and complex tenders, proposals, and commercial negotiations.

• Demonstrated ability to provide leadership, direction, and coordination across Business Development teams, account managers, and framework agreement holders, ensuring a shared focus on market growth and client development without formal personnel responsibility.

• Solid communication and stakeholder management skills, with professional proficiency in both Danish and English.

**A place to work and so much more

**At COWI, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. We support our customers’ transition towards increased sustainability and strive to lead by example by embedding environmental management, social responsibility and good governance into our business practices. We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and collaboration – because that is what brings out the best in you, both at work and at home. With offices primarily located in the Nordic region, the UK, North America and India, we are currently more than 7,500 people bringing expertise in engineering, architecture, energy and environment into play.

**Got more questions?

**If you have any unanswered questions about the role or what we have to offer, please reach out to Senior Market Director Mikael Voldborg, Buildings & Industry, at mivo@cowi.com, or Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist, Janne Nielsen, at jane@cowi.com.

Get to know us better on our website, www.cowi.com, where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy, what we aim to achieve, and what it is like to be part of COWI.

**Before you apply

**All you need to include in your application is your CV – no photo or cover letter required. Please add a short motivation for the role (4–5 lines) at the top of your CV. When it comes to photos, we prefer to form our first impression face to face rather than from a picture. If relevant, please also attach your portfolio.

**Diversity is fundamental to COWI – inclusion is key

**We are committed to creating a respectful and fair working environment where all employees feel a sense of belonging and have equal opportunities to thrive and develop. Our leaders act as role models for inclusive leadership and contribute to a culture where diverse perspectives and professional approaches are seen as a strength. We integrate diversity and inclusion into relevant decisions and processes, and when forming teams across architecture and engineering disciplines. We do this because it is part of our values – and simply because it is the right thing to do.

**Job Description

**

Manager, Strategy & Execution

Posting Start Date: 10/26/26

Alcântara, PRT, 1300‑001, | Gentofte, DNK, 2820,

**Manager, Strategy & Execution

**

• Location: Copenhagen / Lisbon

• Work model: Hybrid / Full time

• Contract type / duration: Permanent

Do you want to lead projects that influence the future direction of global business? Are you curious about how to keep a strategy alive across a global organization? Are you excited by working closely with experienced leaders to solve the most challenging problems in our business? Then you might be who we are looking for!

You will be part of our Strategy & Execution team and work on high-impact, cross-functional projects that help drive STG's strategy forward. You will work directly with the Head of Strategy and the rest of the team, partnering closely with business leaders and subject matter experts across the organization. You can expect to spend your time both supporting the Executive Board decision-making, and working with the business to drive execution. Your contributions will drive strategic initiatives, bring new clarity to complex problems, align stakeholders through challenging trade-offs and ultimately help STG deliver our strategic ambitions. Our team are the stewards of the Focus2030 strategy, and you will play a core part in keeping the strategy alive in the business while remaining responsive to market changes and execution learnings.

This would be an ideal role for an associate-manager level consultant looking to transition into a corporate role so they can take longer term ownership of their projects and see them come to life.

**What Your Day Will Look Like

**As a Manager in the Strategy & Execution team, you can expect to work across a wide range of projects and initiatives. Example projects could include:

• Preparing materials for the Board of Directors strategy days

• Developing a methodology to define future market roles

• Building a business case to optimise our product portfolio to maximise growth and operational efficiency

• Supporting a business team to prioritise their focus areas for the strategy period

• Reviewing our progress to delivering our strategy for the Exec Board

• Creating a new Exec Board KPI dashboard to continuously monitor the success of strategy execution

• Developing a comms plan for Focus2030

**Role

**Your role will vary from developing content yourself to collaborating closely with others, depending on the project or business needs. Your role will often include:

• Project managing complex, cross-functional projects

• Creating insightful analysis (gathering, testing, combining, summarising, visualising)

• Developing frameworks to bring simplicity and clarity to complex problems and decisions

• Working closely with experts and stakeholders to identify and refine recommendations

• Running workshops with senior leaders

• Building slide decks to tell a compelling message

• Managing and supporting the development of more junior team member(s)

What You’ll Bring

• 
You will bring a minimum of 3-4 years of strategy and/or management consulting experience

• 
Experience in a corporate environment (permanent or secondments) is a plus

• 
Problem and decision structuring – experience building frameworks to simplify challenges and decisions to enable the business to move forward

• 
Experience in Consumer-Packaged Goods and/or Retail sectors

• 
Demonstrated project management experience and attention to detail

• 
Strong stakeholder management and team working experience

• 
Demonstrated strong analytical skills including experience delivering complex analyses in Excel

• 
Understanding P&L / key accounting principles / Cashflow modelling is a plus

• 
Understanding of data structuring principles and leveraging multiple data sources a plus

• 
Good slide development skills (storyboarding, content development, polishing) for C-level messaging

• 
A learning and growth mindset – developing yourself and supporting the development of the team around you

• 
Experience and curiosity in using GenAi tools to accelerate and improve your work, including effective prompting, iterative refinement and critical evaluation of AI outputs

• 
Professionally fluent in English

What You’ll Learn

• 
There will be a strong investment in your development where you need it, with a variety of experiences and supportive coaching

• 
This could include:

• 
Deepening your experience in the CPG / Retail sector

• 
Refining your presentation skills, to communicate complex topics in a clear and effective way

• 
Leading projects that are critical to our strategy success

• 
Strengthening your stakeholder management skills in a complex, cross-functional, international organization

• 
This role will give exposure to senior leaders across business globally and equip you to be a transformation leader with extensive experience working alongside C-suite

• 
Our Strategy department, which brings together teams focused on strategy execution, consumer insights, business intelligence, data, and sustainability, will provide you with an opportunity to broaden your expertise across these disciplines too

**Working At STG & What To Expect

**At Scandinavian Tobacco Group (STG), we are so much more than what meets the eye. We combine the strength of global brands with the entrepreneurial mindset that allows people to make a real impact. Here you'll have the opportunity to grow your career, collaborate across borders, and help shape what's next. At STG you'll find more than a role—you'll find opportunities to grow, collaborate across borders, and make a meaningful impact. Our Strategy team brings together over 15 nationalities and 20 languages, for a culturally rich and diverse environment.

We work flexibly and understand the importance of balancing work with your personal life. At the same time, collaboration is a key part of how we work, so you can expect to be in our office in Gentofte or Alcantra at least 3 days per week.

**Our recruitment process

****Requirements

**Before starting our hiring process, your application will be reviewed by a member of our Talent Acquisition team. We assess each application against key competencies and requirements for the role. If your experience and skills are a good match, you'll be invited to continue through our hiring process, which will likely follow the following steps:

• Recruiter Screen

• Team Interview

• Behavioural Assessment

• Leadership Interview with case study

Ready to be part of something bigger? Apply now and discover **so much more.

**Scandinavian Tobacco Group is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

“Please be informed that this Direct Search is conducted exclusively by Scandinavian Tobacco Group. We do not accept applications from agencies, and we will not provide compensation for unsolicited CVs.”

Are you ready to take the next step in your M&A career and gain hands-on experience across the full deal lifecycle in an international company with ambitious growth plans?

We are looking for an M&A Associate, Corporate Development, to join KK Group and support the execution of our M&A strategy and broader strategic growth agenda. This is an opportunity to work across the full M&A process, from identifying and evaluating potential acquisition opportunities to transaction execution and post-acquisition integration.

You will work closely with key stakeholders across the organization, combining financial analysis with strategic and commercial insights to support important investment decisions.

The role offers early responsibility, broad exposure to M&A and close interaction with senior management within an international group backed by A.P. Møller Holding, where M&A is an important lever for future growth.

The position is based in Copenhagen and requires presence in our Copenhagen office three days per week.

Your role

As an M&A Associate in Corporate Development, your primary responsibility will be to support the development and execution of KK's M&A strategy.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Conduct financial analysis, financial modelling and company valuations to support M&A and other strategic investment decisions.

• Support the execution of M&A transactions, including due diligence, coordination of external advisors, transaction documentation and other deal-related activities.

• Screen and assess potential acquisition targets, including strategic fit, financial performance, valuation and key investment considerations.

• Prepare investment cases, including strategic rationale, financial returns, risks and value creation opportunities.

• Conduct market and competitor analysis to identify potential acquisition targets and assess new markets and growth opportunities.

• Work closely with business divisions and relevant functions to assess commercial, financial and operational aspects of potential acquisitions.

• Support post-acquisition integration planning, including identification and assessment of potential synergies.

• Support broader corporate development and strategic initiatives across the Group.

Your profile

We expect you to have 2-4 years of relevant professional experience, preferably from investment banking, corporate M&A, private equity or Big 4 transaction services. Candidates with a background in strategy consulting and strong financial capabilities will also be considered.

In addition, we expect that you have:

• Strong financial and analytical skills, including experience with financial modelling, valuation and financial statement analysis.

• Experience with M&A transactions, financial due diligence or other transaction-related activities.

• A good commercial understanding and the ability to combine financial analysis with strategic considerations.

• Strong proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint, including the ability to develop clear and well-structured decision material.

• A structured and detail-oriented approach, with the ability to deliver high-quality work within tight deadlines.

• The ability to work independently, take ownership of tasks and challenge assumptions when relevant.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate financial and strategic conclusions clearly.

• A collaborative mindset and the ability to work effectively with stakeholders across functions, countries and organizational levels.

• Fluency in written and spoken English.

We value intellectual curiosity, sound judgement and a willingness to take responsibility. You should be comfortable working in an environment where priorities can change, and where you are expected to take initiative, challenge assumptions and contribute actively.

Ready to build your M&A experience, take responsibility early on and contribute to KK Group’s next phase of growth? We would love to hear from you.
